item.title: [SL] Project Litup Volunteer Recruitment ✨📚
item.description: HEY HWA CHONG!! 👋🌟 Ever wondered what learning Chinese would look like without endless worksheets and memorising 成语? 👀 We did too! At Project Litup, we’re on a mission to make Chinese come alive through games 🎲, crafts 🎨, culture 🏮 and laughter 😆—and we’re looking for volunteers to join us! 💛 Project Litup is a student-led initiative that aims to spark primary school children’s interest in the Chinese language and culture through fun weekly enrichment sessions and exciting holiday programmes! 🥳 We partner with Community Centres (CCs) across Singapore to create engaging lessons where learning Chinese goes beyond textbooks 📖 and comes alive through interactive games, stories and hands-on activities! ✨ Some of our favourite activities include… 🖌️ Chinese Calligraphy ✂️ Paper Cutting 🏮 Lantern Making 🎲 Traditional Chinese Games 🎨 Arts & Crafts 🎭 Festival-themed activities ✨ …and lots more!! Whether you’re someone who enjoys interacting with kids 👧👦, wants to share your love for Chinese culture ❤️, or is simply looking for a meaningful way to give back to the community while earning CIP hours 🌟, we’d love to have you on board! No teaching experience? No worries! 🫶 All lesson materials and activity resources will be provided, so all you need to bring is your enthusiasm, a positive attitude and a willingness to have fun with the kids! 🥰 📍 Our Weekly Sessions 🌿 Bishan CC 🗓️ Sundays ⏰ 10.00am – 11.30am 🌸 Toa Payoh CC 🗓️ Thursdays ⏰ 4.00pm – 5.30pm 📌 You’re free to choose whichever location best fits your schedule (or even volunteer at both if you’d like! 🙌). 📚 Worried about promos or exam season? Don’t be! 💯 Our weekly sessions are paused during the promos period, so you won’t have to worry about balancing volunteering with your studies. 🫶 🎉 Besides our weekly sessions, we also organise holiday programmes, where volunteers get to facilitate larger-scale cultural workshops, games and hands-on activities for even more primary school students! 🥳 ⏳ CIP hours will be provided! ✅ If you’re looking to make a difference 🌈, meet new friends 🤝 and help make learning Chinese something kids actually look forward to 📚💛, we’d love to welcome you to the LitUp family! ✨ 📝 Sign up here: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScZiPOuAuuy7810AjSga53bfsFH6_q6kNyr1ie796eXUKWp0w/viewform?usp=send_form 📩 Have any questions? Feel free to DM us on Instagram @project.litup 💬 📸 Follow us on Instagram @project.litup to see what our sessions are like 👀, check out all the fun activities we’ve done 🏮✨, and stay updated on our latest events! We can’t wait to meet you!! 🥹💛 Hope to see you at Project Litup! 🌟🫶 With love, Project Litup 26/27 OT ✨🌈
